fixtures.https://soiljournal.test/leaf-mould:
Leaf mould for small gardens

Fill a wire bin with fallen leaves. Moisten dry leaves before packing.

Keep the pile damp and let it stand for 12 to 18 months. Turn it once after six months if you want a finer result.

Avoid mixing plastic litter into the bin.
